content.name: Amira Choudhury
content.title: Group Financial Controller, FCCA
content.summary: Fellow of ACCA with 16 years in practice, manufacturing and social housing finance. Leads a team of nine across statutory reporting, treasury and payroll for a £210m-turnover group, and steered the move from Sage 200 to Dynamics 365 Business Central on time and under budget.

experience.title: Group Financial Controller
bullets: Lead a nine-person finance team covering statutory accounts, treasury, payroll and service-charge accounting for 11,000 homes.
Delivered group statutory accounts under FRS 102 and the Housing SORP two weeks earlier than the prior year, with no audit adjustments above materiality.
Negotiated a £35m revolving credit facility renewal with two lenders and kept all loan covenants in headroom through a period of rising rates.
Directed the Sage 200 to Dynamics 365 Business Central migration, finishing £40k under its £290k budget.

experience.title: Financial Controller
bullets: Produced monthly management accounts and board packs for a £68m-turnover housing association.
Redesigned the service-charge reconciliation process, recovering £410k of under-billed costs across 2,800 leasehold properties.
Introduced a rolling 18-month cash flow forecast that the board used to approve a £22m development programme.
Managed the external audit relationship and cut the auditors' points from 17 to 4 over three year-ends.

experience.title: Management Accountant
bullets: Built a standard costing model for 1,900 product lines, exposing six loss-making contracts that were repriced or exited.
Ran the monthly close for two manufacturing sites and reported variances to plant managers within four working days.
Led the annual stock count and valuation for £7.5m of raw materials and work in progress.

experience.title: Trainee Accountant
bullets: Prepared year-end accounts and corporation tax computations for a portfolio of 45 owner-managed businesses.
Assisted on audits of charities and academies, testing income, grants and restricted funds.
Qualified as an ACCA member while working full time, passing all papers at first attempt.

achievements.title: Fellow of ACCA (FCCA)
achievements.detail: Admitted to fellowship in 2019 after five years of continuous membership.

achievements.title: £410k recovered
achievements.detail: Service-charge recovery project at Aire Valley Homes, now used as the group's standard process.
